title: Query forms
description: Filters and groups forms, stems, uses or objects from available Trial evidence with and, or, not and typed field predicates, reads forms from the Baseline or a Proposal's Trial copy with parse state and analyses (--as-of, --sides both), runs a motif.query.v2 JSON document (--query-json) or prints its schema (--schema), or runs the saved query of a Parsimony Measure.
usage: Usage: motif query forms --project <fwdata> [--where <selector>] [--group <columns>] [--min-count <n>] [--distinct <column>] [--fold <set>] [--examples <n>] [--ids] [--raw-letters] [--segment-test engine|identity] [--trial <id>] [--limit <n>] [--as-of baseline|<proposalId> [--sides both] [--sort [baseline.|proposal.]<column>[:desc]]] [--json]
